description: Lists the scenes the connected account has finished on nightmarquee.com, newest first: each scene's id, its design's slug, a title, when it was finished and whether it used a product photo. Filter by a design's slug and page through the results with the cursor. Pass a scene id to get_footage to download that scene's footage for the design's starter. Needs a connected account.

cursor.description: The `cursor` from the previous result, to read the next page.

limit.description: How many scenes to return, 1 to 50. The default is 10.

slug.description: Only the scenes of this design, by its slug from search_designs.

name: list_scenes
title: List your finished scenes
